items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Then I went on down with J.C. Heard. And that was really a fine job, 'cause J.C. Heard is so marvelous... I went with J.C. Heard... J.C. Heard band was there... J.C. asked me to play one because Budd Johnson had quit the band.

ctx.x: I'm just curious--just to stop you for a second--how did that come down, who told you that and what...

you know, they told me that things had gotten out of hand; I don't know what it was, something internal, I don't know. There was so many people involved, you know. There was so much money being made and the funds were missing and things like that, you know. And things got a little warm there. So, I had another job to go to. I went down to the Hotel America which was on...I think it was 48th Street. They had a room there called the Bamboo Room and a lot of musicians stayed downtown, some of Duke's men. Paul stayed…
